title: Strichartz Estimates for the Liouville Equation on Euclidean Tori and Applications to Kakeya
summary: We prove Strichartz estimates for the space-time density $ρ$ of solutions to the free Liouville equation on flat tori. In dimension one, we obtain the optimal range of estimates for the density $ρ\in L^p_{t,x}$ in terms of $f_0 \in L^{a}_vL^{b}_x$. In higher dimensions, we prove that such estimates cannot hold and that a weight has to be added: $ρ$ can be bounded in terms of the norm of $|v|^γf_0$. We conjecture a range of optimal estimates, and partially prove them. Finally, these results have natural applications to the $X$-ray transform and Kakeya problems on Euclidean cylinders.
